## Summary

Describe the gateway route, upstream, contract, or documentation change.

## Security and reliability

- [ ] Authentication and authorization are enforced
- [ ] Upstream allowlist prevents SSRF
- [ ] Timeouts, payload limits, and failure behavior are tested
- [ ] Secrets and sensitive data are not included
- [ ] Correlation IDs and redacted logging are preserved

## Validation

- [ ] Unit tests
- [ ] Contract tests with mocked upstreams
- [ ] Integration/health checks
- [ ] Documentation updated
